newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani interbank market rates remain low.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani interbank market rates remain low.

text.p: Pakistan's interbank money market rates remained at low levels owing to the availability of excess funds in the banking system, dealers said.
Early overnight trades were struck or rolled-over at 2.00 and 1.75 percent and the day closed at these levels with the market giving a squarish and surplus outlook, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
Substantial activity was seen in one-week repos as funds changed hands around 7.00 percent, the dealer said.
